Name: Simple UI Themes (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]Description[/b]

[b]Simple Seasonal UI Themes[/b] gives Stardew Valley’s menus a softer, more decorative appearance throughout the year.
The mod includes 12 colour themes—three for each season—with illustrated flowers, berries, vines, crystals, mushrooms, snow, lanterns, and other seasonal details around the menu borders.

By default, the interface changes automatically with each season:
[list]
[*]Spring: Soft Pink - Spring Blossom[/*]
[*]Summer: Warm Cream - Summer Meadow[/*]
[*]Autumn: Soft Amber - Autumn Harvest[/*]
[*]Winter: Ice Blue - Winter Frost[/*]
[/list]Every season has two alternative presets. You can assign any preset to any season or use one theme throughout the entire year.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]12 soft UI presets[/*]
[*]Three designs for each season[/*]
[*]Automatic seasonal theme switching[/*]
[*]Detailed corner and border decorations[/*]
[*]Soft animated glow on illuminated decorations[/*]
[*]Seasonal backgrounds behind the farmer[/*]
[*]Themed menus, inventory slots, tabs, buttons, tooltips, HUD, clock, and money display[/*]
[*]Separate settings for menu, HUD, tooltip, and farmer-background colours[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support[/*]
[*]Optional settings-menu hotkey, unassigned by default[/*]
[*]Supports 36, 48, and 60-slot backpacks[/*]
[*]Adapts to different resolutions, UI scales, menu sizes, and chest layouts[/*]
[*]Supports all 12 built-in Stardew Valley languages[/*]
[/list]Available themes

[b]Spring[/b]
[list]
[*]Soft Pink - Spring Blossom[/*]
[*]Soft Lavender - Spring Wisteria[/*]
[*]Sage Green - Spring Fern[/*]
[/list][b]Summer[/b]
[list]
[*]Warm Cream - Summer Meadow[/*]
[*]Dusty Rose - Summer Strawberry[/*]
[*]Soft Aqua - Summer Lagoon[/*]
[/list][b]Autumn[/b]
[list]
[*]Soft Amber - Autumn Harvest[/*]
[*]Muted Plum - Autumn Twilight[/*]
[*]Cranberry Red - Autumn Cranberry[/*]
[/list][b]Winter[/b]
[list]
[*]Ice Blue - Winter Frost[/*]
[*]Soft Neon - Winter Aurora[/*]
[*]Warm Beige - Winter Hearth[/*]
[/list][b]Adaptive decorations[/b]

Decorations follow each menu’s visible borders and adjust whenever the menu size, UI scale, window size, backpack capacity, or chest layout changes.

Chest storage and player inventory panels are handled separately. Decorations move or shrink to avoid tabs, labels, colour pickers, scrollbars, buttons, inventory contents, tooltips, and the mouse cursor.
If an illustration cannot fit safely, the mod leaves it out instead of cutting it into distracting fragments.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Supports expanded 48 and 60-slot backpacks[/*]
[*]Compatible with Simple Backpack Upgrade and Simple Pouch layouts[/*]
[*]Supports expanded chest menus and changing chest sizes[/*]
[*]Includes compatibility handling for Chests Anywhere, Simple Terminal Storage, Better Crafting, CJB Cheats Menu, and Animated Deluxe UI[/*]
[*]Leaves NPC portraits and letters unchanged for compatibility with portrait and mail mods[/*]
[*]Does not add items, modify saves, or affect gameplay[/*]
[/list]Menus that use completely custom artwork may retain some of their original colours.

[b]Languages[/b]
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]French[/*]
[*]German[/*]
[*]Spanish[/*]
[*]Brazilian Portuguese[/*]
[*]Italian[/*]
[*]Russian[/*]
[*]Japanese[/*]
[*]Simplified Chinese[/*]
[*]Korean[/*]
[*]Turkish[/*]
[*]Hungarian[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]SimpleUIThemes[/code]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want to change themes and appearance options in the game.

[b]Uninstallation[/b]
Close the game and remove the
[code]SimpleUIThemes[/code]folder from your Mods folder.
The mod does not add save data, so it can be removed safely.
Updated to 1.2.1
[list]
[*]Added adaptive decorations for separate chest and backpack panels[/*]
[*]Improved support for expanded and changing chest layouts[/*]
[*]Decorations now adjust automatically to menu size, UI scale, and window changes[/*]
[*]Prevented decorations from covering tabs, buttons, scrollbars, colour pickers, tooltips, and cursors[/*]
[*]Stopped decorations from being cut into partial fragments[/*]
[*]Themed the remaining Collections category tab backgrounds[/*]
[*]Removed the two glow settings; soft animated glow now stays enabled[/*]
[*]Improved compatibility with Chests Anywhere, Simple Terminal Storage, CJB Cheats Menu, and expanded inventories[/*]
[/list]
